title: AI-First Discovery Core Foundation
summary: Introduces a provider-independent AI-first Discovery Core with deterministic fallback, structured intent parsing, hybrid ranking and a Casa Amar domain adapter, while preserving the working explorer and optional day board.
changes: Adds generic Discovery Core 2.0 with versioned normalized asset contracts
Adds an AI model adapter contract for intent parsing and reranking without coupling the platform to one provider
Keeps deterministic search and ranking as a resilient fallback when AI is unavailable
Separates generic discovery logic from the Casa Amar domain profile
Ranks direct intent matches above contextual and nearby suggestions
Models Restaurant Cerros del Águila and Hoyo 19 as multi-moment places for breakfast, lunch, dinner and drinks
Reuses the existing compact explorer, expandable result groups and optional manual day board
Adds regression coverage for ranking precision, adapter separation and load order
test: Confirm v2026.07.24.280 appears on desktop and mobile
Search for strand and confirm beaches rank above restaurants near the beach
Search for morgenmad, frokost, middag and aften and confirm Restaurant Cerros del Águila remains available across relevant moments
Confirm Hoyo 19 appears as one place rather than separate breakfast and evening duplicates
Test category filters, expandable result groups and the compact list
Add, reorder and remove items in Min dag and add a free-text item
Reload and confirm the plan remains locally stored
name: AI-First Discovery Core Foundation
